name: Hill — John P. Ryan Library

geometry.axis_description: U ESE across the hall, V SSW along it; main hall spans V -42.15 to 0. Source research positive-NNE V is negated here.

window_reveal.construction: Panes sit in the outer masonry frame. Extra edge panes bridge one-cell diagonal gaps inside the reveal; nothing is attached outside the building.

evidence.supports: Measured main pitched roof, eastern low addition, ground outline. Ridge attribute 85.44722 m; geometry max 87.1301 m includes small upper features.
Five west arcade arches and upper traceried groups, brownstone and dressed stone, broad staircase, distinct low eastern addition.
2026 footage at 18–24 seconds confirms open arcade, separate flat gravel roof, stairs and current planting; 99 seconds shows the south-end five-light groups.

uncertainties: Facade dimensions are photograph interpretations, not measured architectural drawings; measured LiDAR roof-fit RMSE is 0.583213 m.
Arcade projection and 69.7 m landing are estimated against photographs and adjacent DEM, with roughly 1 m plan and 0.8 m threshold uncertainty.
North lower openings and concealed eastern walls are incomplete; the first study is an exterior starting point for native visual iteration.
Simple floor plates and entrance panels do not reconstruct the library interior, shelves or circulation.
Planting is limited to broad interpreted beds; individual species and positions are not surveyed.
This revision uses only original Minecraft textures. Terracotta dressed trim and mud-brick partial blocks approximate the warm masonry; colour is a visual interpretation, not an exact texture match.
